_doc: Actual native-pixel front-wing profile measurements for joint alignment. This is separate from collision/passages and does not change either. Cap means the same bevel-to-vertical front-face boundary in all four wings; it is not the rear ridge or the first mortar course. Base/coping lines were independently fitted to the actual current sources in art_axis_measure.json; cap lines were newly detected with OpenCV LSD and visually checked in enlarged native crops.
constraint_notes: Targets emitted by the helper are absolute projected-native pixel positions. A solver storing displacements must subtract the source positions. Account for pad_y exactly once.
Feature height is measured against each painted wing base, with a separate report against the whole-gate front plane. Do not silently treat these parallel but offset lines as identical.

Keep metric scale/foot landmarks fixed, or freeze their references while applying targets. derive() currently remeasures wing_height_line and tower anchors after a warp; moving those points changes the scale/foot and invalidates a one-pass position target.
A point with a nonzero target must not also be a zero-displacement pin. A line-angle constraint alone does not constrain its architectural height.

Gate-2 depth needs x and y correction if brought to wall thickness 64. vertical_only cannot reduce its measured 71.1-unit thickness while preserving both isometric axes. Match corresponding top and bottom depth corners; check no folded triangles.

These measurements check profile geometry. They do not assert that independently generated block/corbel patterns match. Use actual gate-wing pixels as the shared wall module to establish that correspondence.

depth_upper.method: The shared front corner is the measured coping endpoint; a 1.3px independent LSD endpoint discrepancy is resolved before triangulation so two source points are not collapsed onto one target line.
